messages:
Alex G.: FYI customer 'Atlassia Labs' (acct 81234) had 3 consecutive card declines this morning. tx ids: tx_01, tx_02, tx_03. Bank reason snippets: `card_decline`, `insufficient_funds`. Should we keep auto-retrying or switch to manual wire/ACH fallback? 
Maria F.: Do we have their billing email on file? I can ping them. Also check if their card on file expired. 
Ryan (Support): They are on Enterprise Dedicated plan. Our retry policy for Dedicated is 3 attempts then manual outreach. We shouldn't keep auto-retrying — risk of card lock/fraud alerts. :warning: 
Alex G.: Good point. I paused retries in the dashboard (changed retry policy for acct 81234 to 'manual') and put a note. Billing Bot: Payment retry job for acct 81234 canceled (job id prj_998). 
Maria F.: I'll draft an email requesting updated payment method + offer ACH/wire. Do we have standard wire instructions to send? 
Alex G.: Yes — use our templated wire block: 
```
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First Example Bank
Routing: 111000025
Account: 987654321
SWIFT: EXAMPUS33
Reference: acct 81234 / invoice INV-2025-045
``` 
Ryan (Support): Also include ACH setup link: https://billing.redwood.ai/ach-setup and note that ACH can take 3-5 business days. 
Maria F.: I'll send the email now and mark as 'urgent — payment failed' and propose a one-time wire if they need immediate capacity. Priya (Legal) — do we need extra approvals to send wire instructions to a customer? 
Legal - Priya: No extra approval needed; confirm the bank details are the templated ones. Avoid including internal account manager numbers. 
Alex G.: Sending email summary to acct team's alias and cc'ing customer success. Draft pasted below for review: 
"Hi — we attempted to charge your card and it declined 3 times. Please update payment method here: <link> or remit via wire using the instructions below. If you'd like we can provision a short-term grace period after payment confirmation. Let us know preference." 
Maria F.: Sent to billing@atlassialabs.com. Also created invoice INV-2025-045 with 'due on receipt'. 
Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2025-045 created and emailed to billing@atlassialabs.com. 
Ryan (Support): I'll monitor for replies. If no response in 48h, open a collections case and notify Sales. :+1: 
Alex G.: Thanks team. I'll reopen the retry policy if they update card. 
Maria F.: Marking thread resolved for now — will update once wire received or card updated. :white_check_mark:
